label_scope.interpretation: Agreement with post-AI-exposure human review by a single reviewer; not independent human ground truth or an official benchmark result

chapters.heading: 01 / A traceable CPU pilot
chapters.text: Yike leads this team-capstone modernization with AI assistance. The recorded viewer uses 77 single-reviewer references after AI-label disclosure.

chapters.heading: 02 / One timestamp, six real views
chapters.text: A reference-positive example: cached SAE score 6.490, above the frozen validation threshold 6.075. This is saved-model playback, not live inference.

chapters.heading: 03 / Inspect an activation direction
chapters.text: Unit 67 links to high-activation examples. Numeric units have no validated semantic names; these examples support inspection, not a causal explanation.

chapters.heading: 04 / False positive: MLP fixed rule
chapters.text: This clear-road frame has a normal reference. MLP probability 0.898 exceeds its fixed 0.5 threshold: an illustrative false positive.

chapters.heading: 04 / Keep decision policies separate
chapters.text: The per-frame table separates the fixed prediction from the validation-selected policy. Error labels here are relative to the submitted references.

chapters.heading: 05 / False negative: the same MLP rule
chapters.text: A bus stop and marked crossing are visible. MLP probability 0.065 is below the same 0.5 threshold, missing this positive reference.

chapters.heading: 05 / Preserve errors for review
chapters.text: Both mistakes use the same saved model and fixed rule. Cases were selected after evaluation for explanation, not for tuning.

chapters.heading: 06 / Compare methods and retain negative findings
chapters.text: The old test has 15 timestamps in two scenes. SAE top-four finds four reference positives; reward and no-reward weights are identical.

chapters.heading: 07 / Export the next review queue
chapters.text: Export 77 candidate rows with blank new-review fields. No new judgments are created in this recording.

chapters.heading: 08 / Scope and next decision
chapters.text: Pilot limits: one reviewer after AI disclosure, one seed, and three normal training frames from one scene.
